educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: EVIDENCE DISCIPLINE
missions.concept: Engineering claims must be separated into verified fact, observation, hypothesis, requirement and verification evidence; confidence cannot exceed evidence quality.
missions.scenario: Evidence quality and independence are given. Set only the strength of the claim you are willing to make.
missions.goalText: Make claim strength match the available evidence.
missions.transferText: Reduce the claim when source independence drops; do not edit the evidence.

missions.title: SYSTEM DESIGN REVIEW
missions.concept: A design review closes decisions only when cross-domain risks, requirements and evidence are visible; attractive presentation is not closure.
missions.scenario: The number of critical issues is given. Build coverage/evidence and close issues explicitly.
missions.goalText: Reach review readiness by closing real issues and evidence gaps.
missions.transferText: Re-open the review until the new issues are actually resolved.

missions.title: ZONE REVIEW
missions.concept: A physical zone must satisfy motion, thermal, sensing, service and safety envelopes simultaneously; local styling cannot be reviewed in isolation.
missions.scenario: A service intrusion is imposed later. Tune shoulder-cover clearance, thermal opening and sensor field-of-view.
missions.goalText: Pass all three envelopes rather than optimizing only one discipline.
missions.transferText: Recover cross-domain margin after the service feature is imposed.

missions.title: REQUIREMENTS & RFIs
missions.concept: A strong RFI turns uncertainty into a precise engineering question tied to a decision, owner and acceptance evidence.
missions.scenario: Ambiguity, criticality and current evidence are given. Improve RFI quality and choose whether to hold or proceed.
missions.goalText: Create an RFI strong enough to reduce decision ambiguity before proceeding.
missions.transferText: Escalate and hold the late requirement while converting uncertainty into a precise RFI.

missions.title: CHANGE IMPACT & TRACEABILITY
missions.concept: A design change propagates through dependent interfaces and invalidates evidence; traceability tells you what must be rechecked.
missions.scenario: Change magnitude and dependency count are imposed. Build retest and traceability coverage.
missions.goalText: Create enough retest and traceability coverage for the change footprint.
missions.transferText: Expand evidence and traceability when the dependency footprint grows.

missions.title: FINAL DESIGN REVIEW
missions.concept: Complete the humanoid review by matching claims to evidence, preserving system margins and tracing change impact across disciplines.
missions.scenario: Final cross-functional review: demonstrate three independent release axes.
missions.goalText: Complete the final three review cases.

gateCases.name: CLAIM DISCIPLINE
gateCases.text: Evidence coverage must be at least 80%.

gateCases.name: ENGINEERING MARGIN
gateCases.text: No release with system margin below 55%.

gateCases.name: TRACEABLE RELEASE
gateCases.text: All three axes at least 70% and weighted review score at least 75%.
